Dreaming of a mustache is mainly associated with wealth and financial matters. In an old source, having a mustache is interpreted as a sign of unexpected wealth, while modern dream books may also give it a cautionary meaning.

## What does it mean to have a mustache in a dream?

In the old source, having a mustache in a dream is interpreted as:

> **“Unexpected wealth.”**

According to this interpretation, a mustache in a dream may symbolize an unexpected material gain or wealth.

![](asset://019c2a10-4e61-7a32-8c15-2a37bcf94d02)

The old entry also separately mentions the case in which a woman sees a mustache in a dream, but the complete interpretation of that case has not been preserved in the available text.

## Modern dream book: mustache

According to a modern interpretation, seeing a mustache on your own face in a dream may mean unsuccessful attempts to earn money through doubtful means.

If you see your loved one with a mustache in a dream, it is interpreted as a sign of betrayal.
